description: Profile a California STATE department/agency's procurement spend from the SCPRS purchase-order data on data.ca.gov: total dollars, purchase-order count, top suppliers (vendors) it buys from, top commodity categories it spends on, and a by-fiscal-year breakdown. Matches the department name as a case-insensitive substring. Answers "what does the CA Department of Justice buy and from whom", "which agencies spend the most". This is CALIFORNIA STATE data (not federal).

department.description: State department/agency name (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Justice", "Health Care Services", "Transportation".

fiscal_year.description: Optional: restrict to one fiscal year, e.g. "2014-2015".

name: ca_procurement_department
title: Ca Procurement Department
